meta.name: polish
meta.description: Pre-release code review - runs lint/type checks, then launches 4 parallel review agents (cleanliness, design, efficiency, side-effect gating) to analyze the diff, synthesizes a unified report, and fixes with approval. Use before committing, pushing, or releasing changes. Triggers on "review code", "check before commit", "cleanup before release", "review changes", "is this ready to ship", "polish before release", "simplify".

copy.tagline: 自动审查代码差异并生成修复报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望在提交或发布前自动获得代码质量审查和修复建议。
